<p class="bms-glossary-term-name">PRAT</p>
<p class="bms-glossary-definition">In backgammon, PRAT refers to a cube mnemonic: Position, Race, And Threats. If you lead in two or more, consider doubling. The term gives players a shared way to talk about this part of the game.</p>
